title: 'You Don't Care About Human Beings:' Video Shows Justin Bieber Unleash On Photographers | The Daily Caller
text:
Justin Bieber lashed out at a group of paparazzi who swarmed him as he made his way to a coffee shop Wednesday in Palm Springs, according to footage.
TMZ shared a video of the famous singer snapping at a male photographer who simply said “good morning” to him as he walked by. Bieber instantly reacted to the cameras in his face, accusing the paparazzi of attempting to profit off his image, seemingly accusing them of not having any regard for him in the process.
“No, not good morning!” Bieber shouted at the photographers as he attempted to conceal his face.
#JustinBieber ‘s not feeling good vibes heading into #Coachella weekend, and he put the paparazzi on notice … calling them out for trying to make a buck off him.
Full article HERE: https://t.co/k9f3MobCxz
📷: https://t.co/kCzEw5J4TO pic.twitter.com/BsTYG0lSxC
— TMZ (@TMZ) April 9, 2025
Bieber appeared with his hoodie loosely draped over him, half-on and half-off, revealing his bare chest at one point.
He quickly raised his hands in the air and gestured as though he had cash in them. Bieber kept repeating the hand gesture as he walked right up to one of the photographers and got in his face. “Money, money, money, money,” he repeated over and over.
He seemed to taunt the paparazzi as he leaned in and kept repeating those words over and over, calling them out for trying to make a buck by recording him.
Bieber marched up to multiple men holding cameras and chastised them.
NEW YORK, NY – JANUARY 30: Justin Bieber is seen on January 30, 2025 in New York City. (Photo by XNY/Star Max/GC Images) Getty Images
“All you want is money — go — get out of here — all you want is money!” Bieber shouted as he walked from one photographer to the other.
“Money, money, money, money, that’s all you care about!” Bieber shouted.
“Money. You don’t care about people, only money” he said as he stared down the cameras and gave the paparazzi more content than they would have otherwise had if he had kept walking by.
Bieber seemed frustrated as he tried to express himself.
“Only money, no people,” he said as he shook his head.
“You don’t care about human beings — go, go, go!” he told them.
The famous singer eventually walked toward his friends who were hovering by the door to the cafe. One of his companions gave him a pat on the back as he guided him inside and away from the cameras.

Bieber has recently posted about working through anger and mental health issues. Fans have been expressing concern for his well-being by commenting on his posts. (RELATED: Judge Orders Nicolas Cage’s Son Into Mental Health Program After Alleged Assault Against His Mother)
He was believed to be in the area to enjoy Coachella festivities. Bieber is not scheduled to perform at the major music event, according to TMZ.
